custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the texture of the carapace. AI generators often struggle with the specific 'wet/glossy' look of cooked or fresh crab shells, sometimes rendering them too matte or uniformly smooth. Check if the serrations on the claws are geometrically consistent or if they melt into the claw body. Verify that the eye stalks connect logically to the head without floating.
image_description: A close-up, high-angle shot of a Dungeness crab (Cancer magister). The image focuses on the anterior portion of the crab, showing the broad, oval carapace with purplish-brown coloration and lighter mottling. Two stalked eyes protrude from the front margin. The large chelipeds (claws) are visible in the foreground, appearing robust with dark tips and serrated inner edges. Several walking legs extend laterally from beneath the carapace. The texture appears hard, calcified, and slightly glossy.
